---
name: Bug report
about: Report an emulation, loading, save, build, or runtime failure
title: ''
---

## What happens

Describe the observed behavior and what you expected instead.

## Reproduction

Give the complete launch command and the steps from startup or reset to the first failure. Include any controller, revision-profile, disk-side, or DIP-switch options.

## Build and image

| Detail | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Commit or build | |
| Operating system | |
| Compiler and version, if relevant | |
| Image name and SHA-256 | |
| Mapper/submapper and region, if known | |
| Header changes or save files needed to reproduce | |
| Last known passing commit, if this is a regression | |

## Evidence

Include the relevant log, assertion, screenshot, or a synthetic/redistributable fixture. Identify affected commercial images by name and hash rather than uploading ROM or BIOS data.

For a save failure, state the media type, write-protection setting, save destination, and exact error. Reproduce with a copy of your media.
